Karthik —

Thanks for the summary. Base and bonus look fine to me for SDE2. A couple of quick notes:

- Can we confirm the comp band midpoint? I want to ensure base isn't above the approved band for this cost center. If it is, we'll need VP signoff.
- For equity, I'd prefer to align with the standard RSU count but tweak the vesting cadence to 4 years with semi-annual vesting after the 1-year cliff (instead of monthly) — simpler for payroll tracking.
- Sign-on: $10k for relocation is reasonable; please confirm whether the candidate will receive it as a lump-sum or reimbursement (tax implications). If lump-sum, finance needs to know for payroll gross-up guidance.

Thanks — approve base/bonus pending comp band confirmation.

Quick input from hiring manager POV: good candidate, strong match to Platform infra team. A couple items to adjust before final sign-off:

1) Equity vesting schedule — prefer staying with standard 4y / 1y cliff but keep monthly thereafter (standard for eng). Switching to semi-annual creates noise for our internal equity tooling and exacerbates pro rata calculations for mid-cycle hires.

3) Sign-on $10k OK. If paid as reimbursement, candidate must submit receipts within 60 days. If lump-sum, Talent/Finance will need to route for gross-up.

Please advise on vesting cadence — Lauren's PR preference differs from mine. Happy to align to whichever is policy-approved.
